name: When should I consider fence stability restoration instead of full replacement?
description: Restore if damage is localized and the main structure is sound; replace if damage is widespread or severe.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider fence stability restoration instead of full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider fence stability restoration when the damage is localized and the majority of the fence structure remains sound. For example, if only a few posts are rotted or loose, repairing those specific points can be more cost-effective than replacing the entire fence. A thorough inspection by a professional can determine if the existing panels and remaining posts have sufficient integrity to support a restoration, which is a key decision factor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restore if damage is localized and the main structure is sound; replace if damage is widespread or severe.
